links.surface: مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ عِمْران الأَشْعَرِيِّ

notes: «حَدَّثَنا أَبي رحمه الله» — the compiler's father, written only as «أبي»: a relation link.
«عن أخيه عمر» is one link, the name alone (rule 7).
«عَنْ أَبي الحَسَن عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ» — an Imam written inside the chain after «عن» stays narrator (owner ruling 2).
needs_ruling (rule 11): «قال قُلْتُ وَلِمَ ذَلِكَ» is a first-person questioner inside the saying with no name; the text does not say whether he is a further link.

notes: «أَخِيهِ عمر» is one link named by the name alone («عمر»), per rule 7.
